name: astro-og-smart-crop
description: Astro integration and dev overlay that tests and adapts OpenGraph and Twitter card previews in development, evaluates platform-specific character and pixel limits to prevent truncation, and prompts Gemini Nano (window.ai.languageModel) to suggest high-impact headline and excerpt variants.

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts src/middleware.ts src/overlay.ts src/limits.ts src/nano-suggester.ts --outdir ./dist && bun x tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir ./dist

author: bhubbard
